sides.snippet: Now Deborah, a prophetess, the wife of Lappidoth, she judged Israel at that time.
sides.verseText: Now Deborah, a prophetess, the wife of Lappidoth, she judged Israel at that time.

sides.snippet: But I don't permit a woman to teach, nor to exercise authority over a man, but to be in quietness.
sides.verseText: But I don't permit a woman to teach, nor to exercise authority over a man, but to be in quietness.
